title: rank-3 generalized Clifford manifold and its twistor space
summary: We introduce the notion of a rank-3 generalized Clifford manifold, defined by a triple of generalized complex structures satisfying Clifford-type relations. We show that every such structure canonically induces a generalized hypercomplex structure. We further describe a natural Spin(3)-action by Clifford rotations, which produces an $S^2 \times S^2$-family of generalized complex structures. The corresponding twistor space is then constructed, and we prove that the induced almost generalized complex structure is integrable.
